purpose: Descriptive fixed-text sensitivity and bounded fresh-attention follow-up on the original long cohort.
upstream_status: Fork execution record, not an upstream ledger entry or verdict. Hardware was supplied before this freeze; no long-cohort behavioral score exists.
order: Largest sender first; remaining included handoffs in prepared-manifest order. The probe result is reused.
outcomes: Per-token KL and top-1 agreement; handoff mean/p90 KL and top-1 fraction; cohort median/p10/p90. Last 32 receiver queries: weighted archived key error, tail mass, matched mass, and conditional error.
stopping_rule: Stop on a failed numerical control, archive bridge, hash check, or OOM. Keep any completed prefix. Resume only with unchanged code, inputs, configuration and runtime; do not relax thresholds from observed results.
interpretation: Descriptive prediction sensitivity, not task success, free-generation equivalence, achievable speedup, or validation of the representation tolerance.
